findings.title: Invalid top-level report omits source_qualification_verified
findings.cause: _empty_report does not use the same nonattestation fields as the normal report factory.
findings.impact: Malformed-but-valid JSON is diagnosed without crashing and cannot return PASS; its report shape differs from the documented schema and a strict consumer can raise KeyError.
findings.fix: Include source_qualification_verified:false in _empty_report; retain original failure evidence and do one focused schema verification. No additional permission or identity check is needed.

static_review.period: Growth/CAGR preserve output anchor, require ordered comparable periods; temporal sums cannot silently concatenate overlaps/gaps.
static_review.roles: Future guidance and explicit assumptions are legal; reported future facts and more-factual result promotions remain UNRESOLVED.
static_review.unknown_provenance: Missing required fact source_ref remains UNRESOLVED. Optional unknown available_by is diagnostic-only; source qualification is never attested.
static_review.precision: Decimal arithmetic; boolean rounding rejected, positive tolerance bounded by explicit display precision and actual expected magnitude, tiny values have no one-unit epsilon floor.
static_review.shape_schema: Bad arity/schema/as-of/shape are structured non-PASS reports. The P2 finding affects a nonattestation field only, not overall status.
static_review.scope: Explicitly scoped cross-entity market share is allowed; no identity reconstruction or permit chain added.
static_review.root_skill_wiring: SKILL.md, review-process.md and review-analyst.md make the tool supplemental and preserve four independent source/process/model reviews.

author_test_evidence_read_not_independen.cli_e2e: CN/HK/US synthetic ledgers, mutations, immutable attempts and cleanup

scope_limits: PASS is declared arithmetic and typed-context consistency only. Source truth, source qualification, complete company numerical coverage, buy-side model quality and W04 economic reasonableness are not signed off.
source_ref, FX source, scope_inclusion, definition and display-precision basis are declared strings; reviewers must read actual evidence and validate their meanings.
Optional unavailable available_by does not block the math tool; the four-review workflow remains responsible for actual publication availability and as-of qualification.
The sum operation checks contiguous flow periods, not parallel business segments. Unequal 52/53-week comparability is not inferred.
No live providers, real-document content, LLM or paid resources were called in this independent review.
